It is really precious compared to what I expected.

meanings.note: Used as conjunction (그렇지만).

examples.text: 역시 우리 신디는 똑똑해. 그렇지만 신디야, 난 잃어봤단다.
examples.trans: Smart as ever, our Cindy—except Cindy, I have already lost a star like you once before.

examples.text: 너처럼 나한텐 소중한 아이였어. 그렇지만 그 아이를 잃고 나니까 네가 왔잖니?
examples.trans: She was just as precious to me as you are—yet right after I lost her, you came along, remember?

meanings.note: Used in spoken Korean dialogue (verb).

examples.text: 무대를 비워둘 순 없죠, 무대는 제가 지킬 테니까 다녀오세요 국장님!
examples.trans: We cannot leave the stage unattended—I will stay behind and guard the stage, so go enjoy lunch, Director!
This expression comes from 'guard'.
I seized a good opportunity.
Let's meet next time (at the next opportunity).

examples.text: 그렇지만 그 관계를 지키려다가 기회를 놓치면요, 저도 놓쳐봤거든요. 지금 생각해보면 원래 지키려던 관계가 뭐였는지조차 기억이 안 납니다.
examples.trans: Yet when you miss your chance trying to protect that safe relationship—I have done that before, and now I cannot even remember what bond I was trying to save.

examples.text: 그러면 단골손님들이 거길 버려! 새 손님 받으려다가 있던 손님도 놓치는 꼴이 된다고.
examples.trans: Then all the regulars walk away! Trying to lure new customers only loses the loyal ones you already had.

meanings.note: Used in spoken Korean dialogue (verb).

examples.text: 잘 생각해보세요, 저런 여자가 의외로 진국일 수가 있다니까.
examples.trans: Give it serious thought—a woman like her can turn out to be the real deal.
This expression comes from 'think it over'.

meanings.note: Used in spoken Korean dialogue (noun).

examples.text: 취해서 거짓말을 좀 했는데 준모 선배님이 기억을 하나 못하나 알아내야 한다는 말씀이시죠?
examples.trans: So you told some lies while drunk, and I must find out whether Senior Joon-mo remembers them or not, right?
Here the word for 'memory' is key.

meanings.note: Short-form negation placed directly before verbs and adjectives

examples.trans: I'm not going to the office today.
I haven't watched that movie yet.

meanings.en: to arise, to come up, to occur
meanings.note: Used with feelings, thoughts, or events (e.g. 실감이 나다, 생각이 나다).

examples.trans: A good idea came to mind.
Tears suddenly came to my eyes.

meanings.note: Used for time or order.

examples.trans: Let's meet next time.
The next station is Seoul Station.
